events.text: Added temp diagnostics (compileToGame live-previewWorld → /tmp/rjit-compile-diag.json; bakeGameFile boot-key → /tmp/rjit-bake-diag.json) to localize where auto-gen signs are lost. Bake reads loadEditorWorld which is being clobbered by parallel sessions (shows Wendy Ave/no-pepe vs user's HMSC/pepe). Awaiting user compile to capture live-session truth.

ROOT CAUSE found via live-session diag: compile diag showed placements stuck on stale 'Wendy Ave' gen set (60) while editor renders live 'HMSC AVE' roads — the gen-sign sync effect only re-fired on generatedPlacements change, NOT when a restore (autosave/hot-reload, frequent due to parallel-session edits) reverts setPlacements to the saved snapshot. So Compile shipped the stale snapshot signs (at old locations) — absent at the user's current intersection. Fix: PaintCanvas sync effect now also depends on props.place.items, re-asserting live gen props after any store revert (no-op guard keeps it loop-safe). Awaiting user verify compile.
